title: Lemonade Cake
description: My Mom used to whip this up fairly easily, and it doesn’t need to be made in a Bundt pan, it just looks better that way. "I hope you like lemons, because this cake is very rich and lemony."
ingredients: 1 (3 ounce) package instant lemon pudding mix
1 (6 ounce) can frozen lemonade concentrate, thawed
½ or more cup white sugar
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Grease and flour one 10-inch Bundt pan. (Or, you could use a 9 x 13 baking dish.)
Combine the cake mix, lemon pudding mix, eggs, sour cream, vegetable oil, and the cold water. Mix until smooth. Pour the batter into the prepared pan.
Bake at 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) for 50-60 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool a few minutes.
Make Lemonade Glaze by combining the thawed frozen lemonade and the white sugar. Mix thoroughly for a nice rich consistency.
Invert the cake and prick all over with a fork or thin poker. Pour lemonade glaze over top of cake.
